obfuscation_indicators: no assurance costs can be recovered
risk_summary: The disclosure is generally quantitative and transparent, showing strong revenue, gross profit, and net income improvement in Fiscal 2012. Key risks include lengthening quotation-to-order periods, cyclical end markets, Canadian project cost overruns with uncertain recovery, and limited tax benefit recognition. The tone is cautiously positive but includes standard forward-looking and accounting-judgment caveats.
